metas.name: Master and Commander: The Far Side of the World
metas.description:
Captures a ship as a complete working system. During the Napoleonic Wars a British frigate hunts a French ship around South America — seamanship, weather and hierarchy, and a captain whose naturalist friend would rather be cataloguing species in the Galápagos.

During the Napoleonic Wars, a brash British captain pushes his ship and crew to their limits in pursuit of a formidable French war vessel around South America.

metas.name: Sorcerer
metas.description:
Captures pure physical tension. Four fugitives in South America take the only job out — hauling unstable nitroglycerin in old trucks through jungle — centred on getting a truck across a rotting rope bridge in a storm, in real time.

Four unfortunate men from different parts of the globe agree to risk their lives transporting gallons of nitroglycerin across dangerous Latin American jungle.

metas.name: Mad Max: Fury Road
metas.description:
Captures momentum as a physical state. Almost no dialogue, one chase out and one chase back — speed, heat and desperation, with a war-rig as a whole society in miniature.

In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a woman rebels against a tyrannical ruler in search for her homeland with the aid of a group of female prisoners, a psychotic worshipper and a drifter named Max.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
metas.director: Bob Persichetti, Peter Ramsey, Rodney Rothman
metas.description:
Captures what a comic book actually feels like to read, in motion. Also a genuinely good story about a kid learning that anyone can wear the mask, by failing at it a lot.

Teen Miles Morales becomes the Spider-Man of his universe and must join with five spider-powered individuals from other dimensions to stop a threat for all realities.

metas.name: Barry Lyndon
metas.description:
Captures a rise and fall narrated like fate already happened. An Irish opportunist climbs 18th-century society through duels, war and marriage, shot like paintings, with a narrator who keeps telling you the ending early.

An Irish rogue wins the heart of a rich widow and assumes her dead husband's aristocratic position in 18th-century England.

metas.name: Lawrence of Arabia
metas.description:
Captures a man inventing himself at desert scale. Nearly four hours: the landscape is a character, and so is the gap between the legend being built and the person inside it.

The story of T.E. Lawrence, the English officer who successfully united and led the diverse, often warring, Arab tribes during World War I in order to fight the Turks.

metas.name: Thelma & Louise
metas.description:
Captures escape becoming irreversible, and friendship becoming absolute. A weekend trip, a parking lot, a gun — then two women driving west, getting freer and more cornered in the same scenes.

An Arkansas waitress and a housewife shoot a rapist and take off in a '66 Thunderbird.

metas.name: Apollo 13
metas.description:
Captures competence under constraint. An explosion in space, and the film becomes people in rooms with slide rules solving the next physical problem before the air runs out — the opposite of lone-hero cinema.

NASA must devise a strategy to return Apollo 13 to Earth safely after the spacecraft undergoes massive internal damage putting the lives of the three astronauts on board in jeopardy.

metas.name: Princess Mononoke
metas.description:
Captures an ecological war with no pure side. Iron Town needs the forest cut to survive; the forest gods need the humans gone; a prince cursed by a dying god tries to see with unclouded eyes.

After a deadly curse forces him from home, young warrior Ashitaka journeys west and is drawn into a conflict between ancient forest spirits, an iron town, and a wolf-raised girl.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description:
Captures decency as something contagious. A bear framed for stealing the pop-up book he wanted to buy his aunt, sent to prison — and the prison improves because he is in it.

Paddington, now happily settled with the Brown family and a popular member of the local community, picks up a series of odd jobs to buy the perfect present for his Aunt Lucy's 100th birthday, only for the gift to be stolen.

metas.name: Atanarjuat: The Fast Runner
metas.description:
Captures an Inuit oral epic told by the community it belongs to. Made in Igloolik, in Inuktitut, with a largely Inuit cast and crew: a rivalry, a murder, and a naked run across the ice told for centuries.

The telling of an Inuit legend of an evil spirit causing strife in the community and one warrior's endurance and battle of its menace.

metas.name: Wolfwalkers
metas.description:
Captures the wild being hunted in the name of order. Kilkenny, 1650: a hunter's daughter befriends a girl who becomes a wolf in her sleep, and Cartoon Saloon's hand-drawn forest keeps breaking out of the town's straight lines.

A young apprentice hunter and her father journey to Ireland to help wipe out the last wolf pack. But everything changes when she befriends a free-spirited girl from a mysterious tribe rumored to transform into wolves by night.

metas.name: RRR
metas.description:
Captures male friendship at blockbuster maximum. Two revolutionaries, a rescue on a collapsing bridge, a dance-off against the British, a man carrying a leopard into a party — three hours that never once do anything at half scale.

A fearless warrior on a perilous mission comes face to face with a steely cop serving British forces in this epic saga set in pre-independent India.

metas.name: Godzilla Minus One
metas.description:
Captures a nation with nothing left being asked to fight again. Postwar Japan, a kamikaze pilot who couldn't do it the first time, and a monster film whose human scenes work as well as its spectacle.

A kamikaze pilot plagued by survivor's guilt seeks redemption when a giant monster he failed to kill is transformed by radiation from atomic bomb tests and lays siege to post-war Japan.

metas.name: Faces Places
metas.description:
Captures art as an excuse to pay attention to people — the lightest, warmest film in this batch. Varda, 88 and going blind, tours rural France with photographer JR, pasting giant portraits of villagers onto their own villages.

Director Agnes Varda and photographer/muralist J.R. journey through rural France and form an unlikely friendship.

metas.name: Valerie and Her Week of Wonders
metas.description:
Captures puberty as a village fairy tale. A thirteen-year-old's coming-of-age rendered as folk-horror dream logic — vampire grandmothers, lecherous priests, possibly magic earrings — where every adult is a monster of one kind or another.

Surreal dream-like tale that combines several themes into one fantastical world.

metas.name: The Saragossa Manuscript
metas.description:
Captures storytelling itself as a folk labyrinth. A Napoleonic officer finds a manuscript and falls into tales within tales within tales — gypsies, kabbalists, ghosts, duels — for three hours in Wojciech Has's nested Polish epic.

Upon finding a book that relates his grandfather's story, an officer ventures through Spain meeting a wide array of characters, most of whom have a story of their own to tell.

metas.name: Ten Canoes
metas.description:
Captures oral tradition's actual structure. In Arnhem Land, an elder tells a young man a cautionary ancestral tale inside which another tale is told, while they hunt goose eggs in the swamp — stories nested for a practical moral purpose, with jokes.

In Australia's Northern Territory, a man tells us a story of his people and his land. It's about an older man, Minygululu, who has three wives and realizes that his younger brother Dayindi may try to steal away the youngest wife.

metas.name: Walkabout
metas.description:
Captures two cosmologies meeting in a landscape older than both. Two white children lost in the Australian outback are found by an Aboriginal boy on his walkabout; Eden and catastrophe share every frame.

Two city-bred siblings are stranded in the Australian Outback, where they learn to survive with the aid of an Aboriginal boy on his "walkabout": a ritual separation from his tribe.

metas.name: Aguirre, the Wrath of God
metas.description:
Captures conquest as a fever that keeps marching after its purpose has rotted. Herzog takes a conquistador expedition down the Amazon until the jungle, the raft and Klaus Kinski's face are all dissolving at the same rate.

In the 16th century, the ruthless and insane Don Lope de Aguirre leads a Spanish expedition in search of El Dorado.

metas.name: The Holy Mountain
metas.description:
Captures meaning stacked in images until it overloads. Jodorowsky's alchemical procession — a Christ figure and seven archetypes played by industrialists and generals — assembles some of the densest tableaux ever put on film, grotesque and deliberate.

In a corrupt, greed-fueled world, a powerful alchemist leads a messianic character and seven materialistic figures to the Holy Mountain, where they hope to achieve enlightenment.

metas.name: The Fall
metas.description:
Captures storytelling as barter. Tarsem spent years shooting a suicidal stuntman's improvised fairy tale to a little girl in a 1920s hospital, across two dozen countries with no green screen; he needs her help, and she keeps changing the story by listening.

In 1920s Los Angeles, a bedridden patient in a hospital captivates a young girl with a fantastic tale of heroes, myths, and villains on a desert island.

metas.name: A Touch of Zen
metas.description:
Captures combat choreographed as calligraphy, then dropped entirely for transcendence. King Hu's wuxia epic follows a scholar drawn into a fugitive's fight against the imperial secret police, ascending through a bamboo-forest duel toward something close to enlightenment.

A lady fugitive on the run from corrupt government officials is joined in her endeavors by an unambitious painter and skilled Buddhist monks.

metas.name: Black God, White Devil
metas.description:
Captures a peasant world where religion and violence are the only available languages. Rocha's Brazilian sertão — a hired killer, a self-proclaimed saint gathering followers, a blind bandit-prophet — is filmed like a folk ballad being sung at gunpoint, in glare and dust.

After killing his employer when he tries to cheat him out of his payment, a man becomes an outlaw and starts following a self-proclaimed saint.

metas.name: Alice
metas.description:
Captures the folk tale as a child's-eye inventory of a household's dangerous things. Švankmajer's Alice moves through a Wonderland of taxidermy, bones and jam jars of pins, stop-motion objects that genuinely threaten her — Carroll's dream rebuilt from junk drawers.

A surrealistic revision of Alice in Wonderland.
